# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For diagnostic investigation plans, avoid ranking hypotheses by likelihood without evidence; label them as an investigation order, and explicitly verify that reference preprocessing matches the production path for real inputs rather than assuming synthetic golden coverage is representative.
- When a user asks for a plan corresponding to a numbered bugstofix.md item, create the dedicated numbered plan file and link it directly from that exact tracker item; do not infer linkage from a neighboring issue or say it has no plan when the user has supplied the plan contents.
